segments.he: הָיָה בַּעַל קוֹרָה רִאשׁוֹן כּוּ׳. אָמַר רֵישׁ לָקִישׁ: שְׁתֵּי פָּרוֹת בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים, אַחַת רְבוּצָה וְאַחַת מְהַלֶּכֶת; בָּעֲטָה מְהַלֶּכֶת בָּרְבוּצָה – פְּטוּרָה. בָּעֲטָה רְבוּצָה בַּמְּהַלֶּכֶת – חַיֶּיבֶת.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: In a case where «the owner of the» cross «beam was» walking «first» and the owner of the barrel was walking behind him, if the barrel was broken by the cross beam, the owner of the cross beam is exempt. «Reish Lakish says:» If «two cows» were «in the public domain, one» of them «prone and one walking,» and the cow that was «walking kicked the» cow that was «prone,» its owner is «exempt.» If the «prone» cow «kicked» the cow that was «walking,» its owner is «liable» to pay.

moves.about: the mishna lemma on the beam-carrier walking first

positions.claim: a walking cow that kicks a prone cow is exempt; a prone cow that kicks a walking one is liable
